question: What division of eight octads is sought to be fully known without limit?
premises: A division consisting of eight octads is identified.
The speaker seeks complete knowledge of this division.
The knowledge sought is without end.
inference: The aim is to fully and endlessly know the division of the eight octads.
uncertainties: anantathā may qualify extent or manner; taken as endlessly
plain_english: I seek to know fully and endlessly the division of the eight octads.
